title: AI-Powered WhatsApp Restaurant Chatbot
summary: An n8n-powered WhatsApp assistant for menu questions, order capture, inventory lookups, and contextual replies.
problem: Restaurant conversations need quick, consistent answers across FAQs, ordering, and inventory without losing context.
solution: A WhatsApp trigger routes messages to a Gemini-powered AI agent with simple memory and Google Sheets tools for FAQs, orders, and inventory before sending a reply back to the customer.
architecture: Case-study context: Restaurant conversations need fast answers across menus, FAQs, orders, and inventory while preserving enough context to avoid repeating the same questions.
Conversation trigger: WhatsApp messages enter an n8n workflow that owns routing and response delivery. Components: WhatsApp Business, n8n.
Agent and memory: Gemini handles language understanding while simple memory keeps the immediate conversation coherent. Components: Google Gemini, AI agent, Simple memory.
Business tools: Google Sheets provides the bounded FAQ, order, and inventory lookups used by the workflow. Components: Google Sheets, FAQ + orders + inventory.
WhatsApp Business messages trigger an n8n workflow and the workflow sends the response back to the customer.
A Gemini-powered agent interprets menu and FAQ questions, with simple memory for immediate conversational context.
Google Sheets provides bounded FAQ, order-capture, and inventory lookups.
outcomes: Client workflow proof connecting WhatsApp intake, memory, FAQ, order capture, and inventory tools.
Kept the workflow proof focused on tool use and state movement.
Made no order-volume or production-scale claim.
